charged.question: When am I charged?
charged.answer: Page credits are deducted when a job completes successfully. Failed jobs do not consume credits.

rollover.question: Do unused pages roll over?
rollover.answer: Page credits expire 3 months after purchase.

refund.question: Can I get a refund?
refund.answer: Contact team@knowhereto.ai for refund requests within 14 days of purchase.

payment.question: What payment methods are accepted?
payment.answer: We accept all major credit cards through Stripe: Visa, Mastercard, American Express, and more.
